text: The client method uses an existing client or creates one. Its short summary names both outcomes clearly. Keep concise combined wording when it is clear; a suggested condition-first sentence form is not a requirement to expand every summary. This is a scoped source example, not proof that every pronoun or contraction is suitable for generated text.
title: A short summary can keep two conditional outcomes together
